color.note: Three tiers, one theme (Grimoire). Tier 1 palette primitives (umber-900, hue-rarity-epic…) hold every raw value; Tier 2 roles (ground, ink, gilt…) and Tier 3 domain roles (rarity-*, damage-*, channel-*, meter-*, delta-*, effect-*) alias them; component tokens (sigil-*, on-sigil, tile, on-tile*) belong to one component. Components read roles and their own component tokens, never a primitive. The viewer groups by name stem, so its first group, "Palette", holds bare role names — Tier 2, not Tier 1. Each usage line names its tier. Each hue family has one job per context, and items, combat and chat each have a hue owner (Foundations · Colour · Allocation).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Level 0: the page ground behind everything, the shell's base colour, the Page and the docked Chronicle. The stage paints a vignette of ground-deep over it.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Below Level 0: wells (inputs, item slots, the inventory grid's gutters), the stage's vignette edges and the letterbox behind stage art.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Level 1: the NavRail, Panels, lists and the JourneyCard. Translucent over the frame's backdrop, never blurred (D-102); where content passes beneath, use surface-solid.

tokens.name: surface-solid
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Level 1 where something passes beneath it: sticky table headers and columns, the floating Chronicle drawer and lg-level-1--float. The opaque form of surface, about what surface shows over the frame's backdrop (D-102).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Level 2, one step above surface: hover, selected and pinned washes; popovers, tooltips, hover cards, menus and toasts.

tokens.name: folio
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Level 3: the Folio, dialog sheets, confirmations and the tour's coach mark. Not lighter than surface-raised: its height reads from shadow-panel.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Above the levels: the flat dimmer behind a dialog, a confirmation, the rail drawer and the tour's spotlight. Never blurred.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Separation and decoration, never an edge that must be seen: row and group separators, the Panel head rule, orbit rings, bounded objects that are not controls. Never the only edge of a control (Foundations · Lines).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Interactive edges: inputs, outline buttons, clickable pills and slots, tab separators; floating surfaces; dotted Ledger leaders. Holds 3:1 on ground, surface, surface-raised and folio (Foundations · Lines).

tokens.name: row-stripe
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. The zebra rhythm: every second row of a dense List or table set to zebra, on Level 1 or the Folio (Foundations · Lines). Never with row separators or a container edge; hover and selection wash over it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Primary text and numerals on ground, surface, surface-raised and folio.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Secondary text, inactive nav and list items, captions; on ground, surface, surface-raised and folio.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Plain disabled controls and the names of locked things only (inactive, so exempt from contrast minimums); a locked name always has a lock or the word 'Locked' beside it in ink-muted (Standards · States).

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Brand brass, with four jobs only: brand and current location (logo, frames, ornament, the active rail diamond, the Nobility mark); the one committing action (solid button fill); the screen's one headline figure; effect magnitudes inside descriptions.

tokens.name: gilt-soft
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Former hover and selected-row wash. No new uses (D-015): hover is surface-raised. Still read by SearchField and JourneyCard, queued in the audit; EntryList left it in D-087.

tokens.name: on-gilt
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Text and icons on a gilt fill (the solid button).

tokens.name: arcana
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Means ready, new, actionable or selected — nothing else: '+ New' tags, 'Ready', 'Claimable', rail badges. Not in item, combat or chat contexts.

tokens.name: arcana-soft
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Wash behind arcana text on small marks only: the new Tag and rail badges — never a row, list item or card.

tokens.name: arcana-glow
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Fill-only mark for selected and ready: the active-tab bar, the selected ring or edge, the ready diamond. A flat fill, never a halo, never text. In item contexts selection is a shape instead.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Loss, destruction and failure — what has happened or cannot be undone: Pending Loot lost, abandoning a dungeon run, a failed save, 'Defeated'. Always with a word or icon; in shell, control and data contexts.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. The wash behind an inline alert about a loss or failure. Inline alerts only — never rows, list items, cards or Tags.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. A confirmed outcome only — 'Upgrade succeeded', 'Saved', 'Floor cleared': ink with the ✓ glyph and the word. Not 'Ready' or 'Claimable', which are arcana. No hue of its own (D-016).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Attention: a reversible risk, insufficient resources, something expiring soon — what can still be avoided. Always with a word or icon, in shell and data contexts; never in descriptions or beside gilt in the same form.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Neutral notices, as text with their word or icon, in shell and data contexts only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. Keyboard focus ring colour (see shadow focus-ring).

tokens.name: changed
tokens.usage: Tier 2 · role. The live-update mark only: a flat wash behind a value that changed by itself — a Bazaar price, a roster status, a payout — on at once, held for duration-reveal, then faded over duration-slow (Foundations · Motion). It says the value changed, never whether that helps the player; never a hover, selected, row or rarity wash. ink holds 9.21:1 on it, ink-muted 4.98:1. The same umber as line, doing a second job as a fill.

tokens.name: damage-bleed
tokens.usage: Tier 3 · domain. Bleed. Kept from the game's current palette: 4.4:1 on surface, 3.9:1 on surface-raised — set bleed numbers on ground or folio, or at 19px bold and up.

tokens.name: damage-burn

tokens.name: damage-shadow
tokens.usage: Tier 3 · domain. Shadow.

tokens.name: damage-none
tokens.usage: Tier 3 · domain. Untyped / true damage.

tokens.name: delta-better
tokens.usage: Tier 3 · domain. A change that is better for the player — judged by benefit, not the number's sign (a cooldown from 8s to 6.8s is better). Always with ▲ or ▼ and a sign: ▲ +12, ▼ −1.2s.

tokens.name: delta-worse
tokens.usage: Tier 3 · domain. A change that is worse for the player, judged by benefit, not sign. Always with ▲ or ▼ and a sign. Not danger: a worse stat is not a loss or a failure.

tokens.name: delta-neutral
tokens.usage: Tier 3 · domain. No change (◇ 0), or a change the game does not judge. Muted ink, always with its glyph.

tokens.name: effect-beneficial
tokens.usage: Tier 3 · domain. A beneficial effect or condition — Empower, Haste — on its Tag, always with the effect's name. Shares lichen with delta-better: both mean good for the player.

tokens.name: effect-harmful
tokens.usage: Tier 3 · domain. A harmful effect or condition — Weaken, Slow — on its Tag, always with the effect's name. Shares madder with delta-worse: both mean bad for the player.

tokens.name: condition-beneficial
tokens.usage: Deprecated (D-023) — use effect-beneficial. A placeholder that was never read; remove after the next release.

tokens.name: condition-harmful
tokens.usage: Deprecated (D-023) — use effect-harmful. A placeholder that was never read; remove after the next release.

tokens.name: sigil-fill
tokens.usage: Component token (Sigil). Hexagon stat badge fill. PageHeader's hex icon also reads it — a known exception (Foundations · Colour).

tokens.name: sigil-edge

tokens.name: on-sigil

tokens.name: tile

tokens.name: on-tile

tokens.name: on-tile-muted
tokens.usage: Component token (StatTile). Tile labels (STR, Armor) and units on tile; follows ink-muted.

styles.name: level-numeral
styles.usage: The hero numeral: the level on a LevelPlate, in gilt, with proportional figures. One per screen, never inside a list; never in a table.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: The Folio title: the one thing the screen is about. One per screen, never inside a list.

styles.name: title-lg

styles.name: title-md

styles.name: title-sm

styles.name: name-header
styles.usage: Names that lead: a character, creature, item or Essence in a header — the TopBar, the browsing list on the stage (EntryList).

styles.name: name-row
styles.usage: Names in rows: items, creatures, Essences and players in lists, slots and Bazaar rows. Takes the rarity colour for items.

styles.usage: Mechanics and running text. In a dense row the line height is 20px.

styles.name: body-compact

styles.name: body-compact-strong

styles.name: lore

styles.name: caption-strong

styles.name: code

styles.name: numeral-headline

styles.name: numeral-stat

styles.name: numeral-row

styles.name: numeral-compact

spacing.note: Two tiers, in rem so spacing scales with text. The 4px scale (space-*) holds every raw step. Semantic tokens name the job: inset (padding inside a container), stack (vertical gap), inline (horizontal gap) and section (between groups); each equals one scale step and the stylesheet aliases it to that step. Change a scale step, not an alias (Foundations · Space & Density).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, keycap padding. (4px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and small controls; gap between stat tiles. (8px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; tile padding. (12px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on small screens; rail item padding. (16px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Top bar horizontal padding. (20px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Folio and panel padding; gap between sections. (24px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between major blocks in the Folio. (32px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Stage inset from the rail and folio. (40px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Rail top padding; space above screen titles. (48px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Stage breathing room around a Constellation. (64px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: inset-sm

tokens.name: inset-xl

tokens.name: stack-xs
tokens.usage: Stack · label to value, eyebrow to title; a Compact cell’s vertical padding. Aliases space-1. (4px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: stack-sm

tokens.name: stack-md

tokens.name: stack-lg
tokens.usage: Stack · groups inside a container; the gap in a Comfortable region. Aliases space-4. (16px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: inline-xs
tokens.usage: Inline · icon to label, value to unit. Aliases space-1. (4px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: inline-sm
tokens.usage: Inline · tags in a row, a Button’s icon and label; the gap between a row’s parts in a Compact region. Aliases space-2. (8px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: inline-md
tokens.usage: Inline · controls in a toolbar; the gap between a row’s parts in a Standard region. Aliases space-3. (12px at the default text size.)

tokens.name: inline-lg
tokens.usage: Inline · control groups; the gap between a row’s parts in a Comfortable region. Aliases space-4. (16px at the default text size.)

density.note: Density modes: Comfortable (identity and detail views, the Folio, dialogs), Standard (the default, for panels and forms) and Compact (tables, inventory, rankings, guild members, combat logs, order books). data-density on a container sets the mode inside it; paddings and gaps come from the semantic spacing tokens. Values are rem.

iconSize.note: The icon size scale (Foundations · Iconography). Line icons are drawn on a 24-unit grid at 1.6 stroke and shown at 16, 20 or 24px; 12px is for inline markers only, drawn solid for it. In rem, so icons grow with the reading-size setting.

tokens.name: icon-marker
tokens.usage: 12px · inline markers only: a solid sign beside a name or on a slot's corner — the Nobility crown beside a body-size name, a locked or favourite marker. Never a line icon: at 12px its 1.6 stroke falls to 0.8px.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: 16px · inline with text and in Compact rows and controls: cost lists, Ledger and ListRow labels, sm Buttons, a condition's icon inside its Tag, the search field, the Chronicle's controls. The smallest size for a line icon.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: 20px · the default: NavRail items, Standard and Comfortable rows and controls, the TopBar's menu.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: 24px · the drawing's own size, for display: the PageHeader's section mark, an empty ItemSlot's slot icon, a JourneyCard's unlock, a reveal's heading.

radius.note: By role, not by size (Foundations · Shape). Regions are square; containers take 2px, controls, tags and slots 4px, popovers and drawers 8px; the one circle is the Presence dot. No pill: nothing takes a full radius.

tokens.name: radius-container
tokens.usage: Containers and rows: Panels, dialog sheets and confirmations, the band SectionRule, and row washes (Ledger rows, rail items, EntryList entries, chat lines, suggestions). Regions — the Folio, Banner, Stage, rail and Page — are square.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Controls, tags and slots: Buttons, inputs, tabs, key caps and clickable CurrencyPills; Tags, count badges and rarity codes; ItemSlots, thumbnails, LoadoutSlots and StatTiles. Focus rings on links and icon buttons follow it.

tokens.name: radius-float
tokens.usage: Popovers and drawers: tooltips, hover cards, menus, suggestion lists, toasts and the floating chat drawer. Only what floats.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: The Presence dot, and nothing else: the circle means presence (Foundations · Shape). Never a count badge, an icon button, a bullet or a portrait.

borderWidth.note: Two widths (Foundations · Lines). A line’s meaning comes from its colour and style; width only sets a selection apart from everything at rest. No other border width is drawn.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Every line at rest: separators, interactive edges, floating-surface edges, the gilt frames, dotted leaders and dashed empty or locked edges.

tokens.name: border-emphasis
tokens.usage: Selection edges only: the selected row’s start bar, the selected slot ring, the active tab and channel bars, the current entry; and Track diamonds, drawn at a size they need. Never a resting edge, and not the focus ring (shadow focus-ring).

opacity.note: Opacity for state (Standards · States · Channels). Opacity fades art only — never text, an edge that carries meaning, or the focus ring, so every word stays at its contrast. Motion fades are separate (Foundations · Motion).

tokens.name: opacity-unowned
tokens.usage: Not owned (Standards · States · Ownership and use): the art of a thing the player doesn't have, in a collection, codex or shop. Its name drops to ink-muted and says "Not owned"; the art alone never carries it.

tokens.name: opacity-drag-origin
tokens.usage: Dragging (Standards · States · Interaction): the place a dragged thing left. It keeps its room, so nothing reflows, while the copy under the pointer lifts with shadow-float on z-drag.

shadow.note: Surfaces are lit like candlelight with soft, dark shadows; nothing glows. The focus ring is a ground-coloured gap plus a solid 2px ring.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Level 3: the Folio, dialog sheets, confirmations, the tour's coach mark and the rail drawer.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating Levels 1 and 2: the Chronicle drawer, popovers, tooltips, hover cards, menus and toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-text-art
tokens.usage: text-shadow for any label set over Stage art (Sigil labels, stage captions).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element (box-shadow, so it follows the radius).

layout.note: Shell dimensions and content breakpoints in rem, so columns widen with the reading-size setting and everything reflows sooner (Foundations · Accessibility · Text scaling). Layouts answer to the width of their region, not the window: content-* are container breakpoints (Foundations · Layout).

tokens.name: content-wide
tokens.usage: Content tier Wide starts here: a region this wide holds four Ledgers side by side, or a list and its inspector at 3 : 2. Container breakpoint; the stylesheet repeats the value. (1088px at the default text size.)

zIndex.note: The layer stack, bottom to top (Foundations · Surfaces & Layering). The game's four values are unchanged (overlay 50, popover 100, modal 200, detached popover 300); the rest fill the gaps around them. Every z-index reads one of these; a scrim sits one below the layer it serves, and art inside an isolated Stage or Banner may sit at −1 and −2.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: Layer 0 · content: the stage, the Page and everything in flow. The default; written only to reset a layer.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: A focused row, or the region the pointer or focus is in, rises above its neighbours inside its own stacking context. Never used across regions.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers, a table's held first column and sticky section heads, over the content that scrolls beneath them.

tokens.name: z-chrome
tokens.usage: The shell's chrome over the stage: the TopBar and KeyHints, and the NavRail column.

tokens.name: z-folio
tokens.usage: The Folio column, which lays its shadow over the stage, and the docked Chronicle beside or under it.

tokens.name: z-chat-float
tokens.usage: The floating Chronicle drawer, which may be dragged over the Folio, and the Chronicle's bottom dock on small screens.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: The rail drawer on small screens and its scrim (one below). The game's value.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, tooltips, hover cards, menus and suggestion lists opened from the page. The game's value.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: A dialog and its scrim (one below). Only one at a time. The game's value.

tokens.name: z-confirm
tokens.usage: A confirmation and its scrim, over the dialog that opened it. One at a time; it opens nothing else.

tokens.name: z-popover-detached
tokens.usage: Popovers portaled to the body from inside a dialog or a confirmation, so they sit above it and are never clipped by it. The game's value.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts: brief outcomes, over every page layer and dialog. They never take focus.

tokens.name: z-tour
tokens.usage: The guided tour (First Steps): its spotlight scrim and coach mark, over everything it may point at.

tokens.name: z-drag
tokens.usage: A drag preview under the pointer, over everything, the tour included.

motion.note: Durations and easings (Foundations · Motion). Quiet: nothing bounces, overshoots or loops — only an indeterminate progress indicator and live combat playback may — and only transform and opacity animate. Under reduced motion the tokens keep their values and every transition and animation ends at once.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: No transition. A press going down, a selection or toggle landing, the current location moving, a drag following the pointer (the floating Chronicle), a drawer that collapses into its bar. And what every category becomes under reduced motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Feedback and state: a hover wash fading in and out, a press releasing, a Sigil settling at its selected size, a tooltip or hover card, a live Meter following combat ticks, and anything leaving — a drawer closing, a popover going.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Spatial, arriving: the rail drawer sliding in and its scrim, the Chronicle's body rising in as it opens, a sheet, content a toggle opens.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Value change: a Meter filling to a new step, a number counting to a value the player caused (after combat, after a purchase). Also the live mark fading out.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Reveal: a reward or result appearing — victory, loot, a craft, a level — once per result. Also how long the live mark holds before it fades. The longest duration: no transition runs longer.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Something changing where it stands: hover and press washes, a selection settling, a Meter's fill, a count, the live mark's fade.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Something arriving: a drawer sliding in, a popover, a reveal. Decelerates into place and never overshoots.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Something leaving: a drawer closing, a popover fading out, always at duration-fast. Accelerates away.
